Evaluation contract

Every displayed local score uses the same 2,048 image pairs, positive-class pixel metrics and fixed preprocessing. The decision threshold is fixed at 0.5; there is no threshold fitting or model training. Published scores using another crop protocol are labelled as context and are not silently treated as head-to-head results.
